steps.text:
The M1 build has stopped, and I don't think another retry can fix it. 0 of 30 tasks have landed, no agents are running, and M1-T01 (the interface task) is blocked, holding the other 29.

**Why:** the agent escalated again. In its words:

> Not an intent test: a build-setup bug that no code can fix, so 'the test stands' cannot unblock M1-T01. dt land and stop_gate.sh always run `scripts/check.sh gate --pkg rllab`, but pkg_scope in protected scripts/check.sh lists only components (core..cli), so it exits 64 'unknown package rllab' before any check runs. Reproduced just now in this worktree. Every M1-T01 solo attempt (2, 4, 6) was rejected for this alone.

This is the fourth agent to give the same cause. The gate stops on the package name before it checks any code, so nothing an implementer writes can pass it. Each retry also throws away a full interface build of about 25 minutes. The detail file is `.git/dt-build/details/M1-T01.solo-7.txt`.

**Decide:**
1. **Fix the bar** (recommended). Run `build-setup` Revise so `pkg_scope` in `scripts/check.sh` accepts `rllab`, the single package, as the whole scope. You'd approve the change, I'd commit it on `build/M1`, and then I'd rerun M1-T01.
2. **Change `dt`** so it passes no package name for a single-package project. That's a fix to the plugin rather than this project, and it's outside what the build can do.
3. **Retry again** with `--test-stands`. I don't recommend it: by every agent's account, it will fail the same way.

I'll record your answer with `dt build resolve` before doing anything else. Nothing has been merged, and `main` is untouched.
